setup.error: I couldn’t read how setup is going. What you kept is safe.
setup.welcome.title: Keep anything. Nocturne sleeps on it and hands you one page each morning.
setup.welcome.body: It remembers what matters, lets go of what doesn’t, and shows you where every answer came from.
setup.welcome.promise.detail: No account. No cloud. Works without internet once it’s set up.
setup.checking.title: Checking this computer…
setup.checking.body: Looking at its memory and free space. This takes a few seconds.
setup.result.large: This computer is powerful. Nocturne will use its best mind.
setup.result.standard: Nocturne will use a lighter mind. Everything works; tidying takes a little longer.
setup.result.small: Nocturne will use its smallest mind. Everything works; answers and tidying are slower.
setup.result.unsupported.memory: This computer doesn’t have enough memory for Nocturne yet.
setup.result.unsupported.disk: This computer needs more free space for Nocturne.
setup.unsupported.memory.detail: It has {ram} GB. Nocturne needs {min} GB or more. Nothing has been downloaded.
setup.unsupported.disk.detail: It has {free} free. Nocturne needs {needed} to set up. Free some space and check again. Nothing has been downloaded.
setup.tier.label: How much to set up
setup.tier.detail: {ram} GB or more · {size} to set up
setup.tier.toobig: Needs more memory than this computer has
setup.needs: Nocturne needs {size} of space (you have {free} free). It downloads once, and you can start keeping things straight away.
setup.why.body: Nocturne picks the biggest mind this computer can run comfortably, which depends on its memory: {ram} GB here. Large needs {large} GB or more, Standard {standard} GB and Small {small} GB. A smaller mind only means answers and tidying take longer. Everything still works.
setup.ready.title: While Nocturne gets ready, keep your first thing.
setup.keep.title: Photograph a letter, drop a file, or say something.
setup.keep.body: It’s kept the moment you add it. Nocturne reads it as soon as it’s ready, or tonight.
setup.keep.note.label: Your note
setup.keep.failed: I couldn’t keep that just now. Nothing is lost; try again.
setup.progress.label: Setting up Nocturne’s mind
setup.progress.safe: Safe to close. It carries on next time, even after losing Wi-Fi.
setup.paused.offline: Waiting for the internet. It carries on by itself.
setup.paused.battery: Paused while on battery. It carries on when plugged in.
setup.installing: Almost there. Nocturne is putting the last pieces in place.
setup.error.notEnoughMemory: This computer doesn’t have enough memory for Nocturne yet. Nothing has been downloaded.
setup.error.engineFailed: Nocturne couldn’t finish getting ready. What you kept is safe.
setup.action.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was lost; try again in a moment.
setup.done.title: Nocturne is ready.
setup.done.body: Your first page arrives tomorrow morning. Keep anything in the meantime.
setup.defaults.title: Good defaults · change any time
setup.defaults.login.hint: So the tidy can run overnight
setup.tonight.title: Tonight
setup.tonight.body: When this computer is plugged in and idle, Nocturne reads what you kept, links it together and writes your first page. If the lid is closed, it catches up when you open it.
